conventions: Choice variant is the existing 'mode' value (single/multiple): Choice deliberately has no control prop because the renderer picks radio/select/segmented/chips/cards. Segmented controls that switch views go to Views 'segmented'.
Chart variant is the 'intent' value; new intents are listed as new variants.
Text 'format:*' variants are Format.type values applied to Text (and equally to DetailList/Table cells).
Status variant is the kind or the 'inline' variant that expresses the entry.
Timeline (proposed) is covered by Collection layout 'timeline', so timelines map there as existing.
